Myths on Clay tells the Norse myths in the style of carved Viking runestones, one story at a time. Season 1, The Saga, tells the whole story from Ginnungagap to Ragnarök; Season 2 follows the heroes of the North.
Sources: the Poetic Edda (Völuspá, Hávamál, Grímnismál, Vafþrúðnismál), Snorri Sturluson's Prose Edda, the Ynglinga saga.
Narrated by Matías.
